name: shared-config
description: Shared tooling configuration for chewygumxx repositories

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:md && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:toml && bun run lint:sh && bun run lint:editorconfig && bun run lint:actions && bun run lint:package && bun run lint:deps && bun run lint:spell && bun run lint:secrets
scripts.format: biome format --write . && bun run format:yaml && bun run format:toml && bun run format:sh
scripts.format:sh: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 -r shfmt -f | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r shfmt -w
scripts.lint:md: git ls-files -z '*.md' | xargs -0 -r remark --frail --quiet --no-stdout && git ls-files -z '*.md' | xargs -0 -r markdownlint-cli2
scripts.lint:package: sort-package-json --check package.json packages/*/package.json && for dir in packages/*/; do publint --level warning "$dir" || exit 1; done && for dir in packages/*/; do test ! -f "$dir/index.d.ts" || attw --pack "$dir" --profile esm-only || exit 1; done
scripts.lint:sh: git ls-files -z | xargs -0 -r shfmt -f | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r shfmt -d && git ls-files -z | xargs -0 -r shfmt -f | tr '\n' '\0' | xargs -0 -r shellcheck
scripts.lint:toml: git ls-files -z '*.toml' | xargs -0 -r tombi format --check --offline -- && git ls-files -z '*.toml' | xargs -0 -r tombi lint --error-on-warnings --offline --
scripts.lint:yaml: git ls-files -z '*.yaml' '*.yml' | xargs -0 -r prettier --check && git ls-files -z '*.yaml' '*.yml' | xargs -0 -r yamllint --strict
